notes.content:

If you haven't yet bought the game, now's the time! It's 25% off for the next seven days.

Here's a nice write up to whet your appetite: https://waypoint.vice.com/en_us/article/bucket-detective-the-story-of-a-a-sad-asshole-who-joined-a-cult

And if you like the game, tell a friend or write a review. It really does help.

- jesse
